payload.note: Unique-critical-point checkpoint: on every finite connected undirected graph, the residual-square BT action has only the constant vacuum as a critical point modulo shifts. The exact factorization Dr=-diag(Omega)^(-1) K diag(Omega), the positive-ground-state kernel of K, and sum Omega*r=0 force any critical residual r=c Omega^2 to vanish. Thus extra finite-volume wells and a multiwell explanation of the Witten barrier are ruled out. An exact positive rational field embedded in the 4^4 torus has ||grad A||^2/||r||^2<omega_4^2=4, obstructing the sharp free-coefficient gradient inequality. A weaker L-uniform normalized gradient bound, its Poincare/Witten bridge, interacting H^-1 control, continuum reconstruction, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian claims remain open.
